notes: Ordered Overpass mirrors, shared by lib/overpass_client.py (location-segment, osm_places) and lib/day-excursions.js. Probed from the host 2026-10-20: overpass.openstreetmap.fr 200 in 0.8s; maps.mail.ru 200 in 16s; overpass-api.de refuses connections (down/blocking since ~2026-10-16, with no venue source the live question offered bare street addresses); kumi, private.coffee, openstreetmap.ru, openstreetmap.ie timed out; overpass.osm.ch is Switzerland-only. NextGIS offers a free keyed instance if more are ever needed. Resilience lives in overpass_client.py: the last mirror that answered goes first; a failed mirror backs off (2 min doubling, 30 min start for a refused connection, max 120); per_mirror_s caps one attempt inside the caller's overall deadline; health in data/.cache/overpass-health.json, failures in data/overpass-log.jsonl; the watchdog pages when no mirror has answered for 6 h.
